title: Aşırılar Apartmanı
author: Öznur Duyum
description: In the bustling House of Extremes, every resident is larger than life and completely unpredictable. Lazy naps anywhere, Chatterbox never stops talking, Lightning bakes at incredible speed, Dreamer invents wild ideas, Noise drives everyone crazy, Clumsy breaks everything, and Grumpy is always ready to argue. When the daily chaos overwhelms them, the residents demand a meeting. Eccentric conflicts and comic mishaps continue until surprising solutions bring harmony back to the apartment. The story celebrates creativity, empathy, and finding ways to live together despite differences.
